generator_cmd: copied from tapcode-cobalt.json: classic 5x5 tap code (C/K merged) of the sentence letters, pycipher + awk
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | awk '{n=split($0,a,"  ");for(i=1;i<=n;i++){split(a[i],b," ");printf "%d%d",length(b[1]),length(b[2])}}' | perl -ne '@g=split//,"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789";s/\D//g;print map {$g[(substr($_,0,1)-1)*6+substr($_,1,1)-1]} /(..)/g'  # read on the 6x6 grid -> letters g-z, not hex -> none
